topic: Ski day morning: {健太|けんた} is late
context: Thursday 10 December, the {白馬|はくば} ski day. Before dawn {健太|けんた} reminds アルちゃん not to oversleep, passes on the snow forecast and {沙織|さおり}'s advice on falling, then is late himself because of snow clearing.
scene: Thursday, 6 a.m., ski day! {健太|けんた} messages you before you meet at the station. He has lots of things he heard.

phrases.jp: {天気予報|てんきよほう|weather forecast|4}によると、{明日|あした}は{大雪|おおゆき|heavy snow|3}だそうです。
phrases.en: According to the forecast, there'll be heavy snow tomorrow.
phrases.note: Review: source + によると + そうです/らしい.

phrases.jp: {怪我|けが|injury|4}しないように{気をつけて|きをつけて}ね。
phrases.en: Be careful not to get hurt.
phrases.note: {怪我|けが}する = get hurt. Said before any sport or trip.

phrases.jp: {着いたら|ついたら}{連絡|れんらく}してね。
phrases.en: Message me when you get there.

phrases.jp: {無理|むり}しないでくださいね。
phrases.note: Kind words to anyone tired, sick or trying something new.

phrases.jp: {寝坊|ねぼう}したら、{置いて|おいて|to put; leave behind|4}いくよ。
phrases.en: If you oversleep, we're leaving without you.
phrases.note: {置|お}いていく = go and leave someone behind. Teasing between friends.

dialogue_setting: A LINE chat with {健太|けんた} before dawn, while you get ready in your room at the {田中|たなか} house.

dialogue.speaker: 健太
dialogue.jp: おはよー！{起きてる|おきてる}？{寝坊|ねぼう}したら{置いて|おいて|to put; leave behind|4}いくで
dialogue.en: Morning! You up? If you oversleep, we're leaving without you.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: {起きてる|おきてる}よ！{集合|しゅうごう}、7{時|じ}だっけ？
dialogue.en: I'm up! We meet at 7, right?

dialogue.speaker: 健太
dialogue.jp: せや、7{時|じ}に{駅|えき}って{決めた|きめた}やん
dialogue.en: Yep, we said 7 at the station.
dialogue.note: せや = そうだ, やん = じゃない (Kansai).

dialogue.speaker: 健太
dialogue.jp: {天気予報|てんきよほう|weather forecast|4}によると、{白馬|はくば}は{昼|ひる}から{大雪|おおゆき|heavy snow|3}らしいで
dialogue.en: According to the forecast, there'll be heavy snow in {白馬|はくば} from midday.

dialogue.speaker: 健太
dialogue.jp: {翔|しょう}さんの{話|はなし}やと、{朝|あさ}はパウダーやって！
dialogue.en: {翔|しょう}さん says the morning's powder snow!
dialogue.note: やと = だと, やって = だって (they say), Kansai.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: マジ？{初心者|しょしんしゃ}でも{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}かな…
dialogue.en: Really? Will I be OK as a beginner…

dialogue.speaker: 健太
dialogue.jp: {沙織|さおり}{言うてた|いうてた}けど、{転んで|ころんで}{手|て}を{つく|つく|to put (hand) on the ground|3}と{手首|てくび|wrist|3}{骨折|こっせつ|broken bone|3}しやすいねんて
dialogue.en: {沙織|さおり} said if you fall and put your hand out, it's easy to break your wrist.
dialogue.note: 言うてた = 言っていた, ねんて = んだって (Kansai hearsay).

dialogue.speaker: 健太
dialogue.jp: ごめん！{雪かき|ゆきかき|shovelling snow|3}してたら{遅なった|おそなった|(Kansai) = 遅くなった, got late|2}！10{分|ぷん}{待って|まって}て！
dialogue.en: Sorry! I was shovelling snow and now I'm late! Wait ten minutes!
dialogue.note: {遅|おそ}なった = {遅|おそ}くなった (Kansai).

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: {置いて|おいて}いくよ〜ｗ {駅|えき}で{待って|まって}るね
dialogue.en: We're leaving without you lol. I'll wait at the station.

listening.intro: At the bottom of the slope, {健太|けんた} reports what the lift staff told him.

lines.jp: {係|かかり|staff in charge|3}の{人|ひと}によると、{上|うえ}はもう{吹雪|ふぶき|snowstorm|3}らしいで。
lines.en: According to the staff, it's already a snowstorm up top.

grammar.form: source + によると ({天気予報|てんきよほう}によると, {先生|せんせい}によると) · ends with: 〜そうだ / 〜らしい / 〜って ({大雪|おおゆき}だそうだ, {大雪|おおゆき}らしい)
grammar.explanation: Review: によると names where you heard something, and the sentence must end with a hearsay ending (そうだ, らしい, って). In casual speech people often swap it for 〜の{話|はなし}だと or 〜が{言|い}ってた. Don't end it with a plain statement.

examples.jp: ニュースによると、{電車|でんしゃ}が{止まって|とまって}いるそうです。
examples.en: According to the news, the trains have stopped.

examples.jp: {先生|せんせい}によると、{明日|あした}は{休み|やすみ}らしいよ。
examples.en: According to the teacher, tomorrow's a day off.

quiz.question: {天気予報|てんきよほう}＿＿、{午後|ごご}から{雪|ゆき}だそうだ。
quiz.en: According to the forecast, it'll snow from the afternoon.
quiz.explain: The source of information → によると. によって is 'depending on' or 'by'.

quiz_more.question: {沙織|さおり}さんによると、{手首|てくび|wrist|3}を{骨折|こっせつ|broken bone|3}しやすい＿＿。
quiz_more.en: According to {沙織|さおり}さん, it's easy to break your wrist.
quiz_more.explain: によると needs a hearsay ending: そうだ.

quiz_more.question: {翔|しょう}さん＿＿{話|はなし}だと、{朝|あさ}はパウダーだって。
quiz_more.en: From what {翔|しょう}さん says, the morning's powder.
quiz_more.explain: Casual version: person + の{話|はなし}だと = 'from what X says'.

kanji.where: The sign at the bottom of the ski lift: リフト{乗り場|のりば}.
kanji.breakdown: {乗|の}り{場|ば}: 乗 ride + 場 place → 'the place where you get on'.
kanji.related: {降|お}り{場|ば} = where you get off (at the top of the lift). Also バス{乗|の}り{場|ば}, タクシー{乗|の}り{場|ば}.

tip.title: Hearsay, Osaka style
tip.body: In Kansai, だって becomes やって and 〜んだって becomes 〜ねんて. So {健太|けんた}'s 「パウダーやって」 is just 「パウダーだって」. Understand it, but stick to standard forms yourself.

challenge.prompt: Evening. {健太|けんた} posts a photo in 「{白馬|はくば}いこ」: you, face-first in the snow. 「アルちゃん、{今日|きょう}{10回|じゅっかい}{転んだ|ころんだ}ｗ」 You're embarrassed. Which sticker?
challenge.explanation: {恥|は}ずかしい… says 'so embarrassing', the honest reaction to that photo. やった！ would mean you're proud of falling, {承知|しょうち}しました is stiff work keigo, and おやすみ ends the chat.

vocab.note: {置|お}いていく = go and leave behind. {置|お}いてきた = left it (at home).
{天気|てんき} + {予報|よほう} forecast. Check it before every mountain trip.
On the news: {大雪警報|おおゆきけいほう} = heavy-snow warning.
{手|て}をつく = put your hands down to catch yourself.
{手|て} hand + {首|くび} neck → the hand's 'neck'. Ankle = {足首|あしくび}.
{骨|こつ} bone + {折|せつ} break. {骨折|こっせつ}する = break a bone.
かく = scrape. Every snowy morning in {鷹ノ原|たかのはら}.
{怪我|けが}する = get hurt. Often written in kana: ケガ.

kanji_study.parts: 扌 hand radical + 斤 an axe → a hand with an axe snapping a branch: break, fold.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 析 (analyse): 析 has 木 tree on the left, 折 has 扌 hand.

kanji_study.parts: 氵 water radical + 夬 a cut, a gap → water bursting through a broken bank, no going back: decide.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 快 (pleasant): 快 has 忄 heart on the left, 決 has 氵 water.

items.jp: {初級|しょきゅう|beginner level|3}コース
items.note: Then {中級|ちゅうきゅう}, {上級|じょうきゅう}.

items.jp: {滑走禁止|かっそうきんし|no skiing (sign)|2}
items.note: Red sign at the edge of the run. Bears, cliffs or both.

extras.title: Small injuries
extras.intro: To tell the doctor (or {沙織|さおり}さん) what happened.

items.jp: {擦りむいた|すりむいた|to scrape (skin)|3}
items.note: Knees on ice, elbows on snow.
